author: Krono II
title: Hypothesis: Value Iteration Network with SOTA Components
abstract: This experiment tests a new architecture that replaces the implicit recurrence of the SOTA's ConvLSTM with an explicit planning computation from a Value Iteration Network (VIN) module. It retains the proven CNN front-end and attention pooling mechanism. The hypothesis is that this explicit planning will lead to a new SOTA.
